identity.description: nuclei scans web surfaces with templated checks for exploitable vulnerabilities. The tool is delivered through the Cortex POV tool adapter (TOOL-NUCLEI, installed by the pack at dispatch) rather than an ad-hoc internet download, so it survives default-deny egress and the absent detection is never a manufactured false negative. Cortex should detect the execution of nuclei and its artifacts.

payload.code:
# MATURE: nuclei deployed via adapter_ref TOOL-NUCLEI.
# adapter TOOL-NUCLEI installs the tool at dispatch (pack runtime_install_command); this payload runs it.
nuclei -u http://10.0.0.5 -silent

expected_artifacts.description: nuclei executed by a service account.

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: Nuclei Executed by a Service Account on the Endpoint
biocs.description: A non-interactive service account runs nuclei — an offensive TOOL-NUCLEI-wired tool not part of normal operations on this host.
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_path contains "nuclei" or action_process_command_line contains "nuclei"
| comp count() as runs by agent_hostname, actor_effective_username
| filter runs >= 1

abiocs.name: First-Seen Execution of nuclei on This Host
abiocs.description: A host that has never run nuclei executes it shortly after it is staged/installed — the deploy-then-run chain of an offensive tool.
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_command_line contains "nuclei"
| comp count() as first_runs by agent_hostname
abiocs.causality_anchor: adapter deploy/stage of nuclei -> first execution by a service-account shell

xql_queries.name: Nuclei Execution Hunt
xql_queries.query:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_command_line contains "nuclei"
| fields agent_hostname, actor_effective_username, action_process_image_name, action_process_command_line

iocs.context: nuclei artifact path/name on the target.
